name: Resistor Environment QA 18
description: Multiple choice question about electricity, resistors and current QA: A junction has three resistors R1 = \SI{10}{\ohm} (with V1=20V), R2 = \SI{5}{\ohm} (with V2 = 10V), ...

examples.input:
A junction has three resistors R1 = \SI{10}{\ohm} (with V1=20V), R2 = \SI{5}{\ohm} (with V2 = 10V), R3 = \SI{2}{\ohm} (with V3 = -10V). The potential at junction Vmid is:

Options:
1. -10/8 V
2. 10 V
3. 0 V
4. 5 V
